entries.text: Icons and even spacing for the update settings on the About page
Pause live updates on desktop while the screen is asleep or locked
Install macOS updates from inside the app
Proxy groups unfold smoothly as one block
Connection, request, DNS, outbound IP and log details use smaller text with more room
List rows follow a smaller text size, as they already did a larger one
The phone tab bar spaces five tabs and sets out icons and labels as iOS does
The automatic update check and the update channel moved from General settings to the About page
Filter logs from a button beside search
Set the log level from the Logs page

Connections become Requests: connections by minute with All, Active and Failed counts, conditions on app, exit, rule or protocol, a timeline for each connection, DNS queries, segments that keep their place, and new rows held under a desktop pointer
Choose between stable and prerelease updates in the settings; the prerelease check finds the newest release and names the installed prerelease
Lists and cards share one set of margins, so rows line up across pages
The dashboard's outbound mode card is titled Outbound, leaving its mode buttons more room
Grouped lists match iOS 27: row heights, margins, corners and section spacing
On desktop, Logs moves from the sidebar into Tools
Connections on macOS, Windows and Linux show the icon of the app that made them
Requests sits right after Proxies in the desktop sidebar
Connections that failed to connect now show in the requests list, with the reason
When an update has no file to download, the app opens the release page to download it by hand
A rounder, larger delay test icon on proxy cards
Navigation bar tabs fit their titles, and a tap near a tab's edge selects it
Live connections on the dashboard open on the active ones
The rule type picker and rule lists show rule types as profiles write them, such as DOMAIN-KEYWORD, and rule search finds a rule by that name
A stop whose answer is lost with the connection to the core no longer turns the proxy back on when the core comes back
Restarting the core with TUN on no longer hangs when it has to ask for authorization again
On desktop, a restart asked for while the core is still starting, such as after installing the helper, now restarts it, and the core can start again after a start whose local connection setup hung
On Android, stopping while the core is still starting no longer leaves it running, and a start that failed while sending settings to the core no longer blocks the next start
Recheck watched service failures with backoff
Service checks recover automatically when a chain switches to a working front proxy
Dashboard checks wait for startup to finish when you tap Start as the app opens
Shorter descriptions in network, DNS and general settings
Segmented controls follow the system's reduce motion setting
Screen readers can now switch the dashboard's outbound mode
On wider phones the top bar buttons line up with the list cards below them
Opening search puts the cursor in its field even when something else on the page has the focus
App icons in access control and connections load from the cache instead of being redrawn every day
On macOS, connections show the app that opened them again
A hidden window no longer takes the foreground from a full-screen game on Windows
The Linux window is no longer drawn shifted toward the bottom left on NVIDIA and other drivers without glBlitFramebuffer
When the menu bar or tray icon cannot be shown, the log says why
Intel Macs render with Skia again, fixing the hang at launch on older GPUs
Service checks show the address Claude and ChatGPT actually saw, not only the node's exit address
Gemini check no longer reports Hong Kong and Macau nodes as unsupported
macOS no longer collects defunct dscacheutil processes each time TUN is turned on or off
The default bypass list no longer skips the proxy for public 172.2* addresses, and the default fake-ip filter names Windows' real connectivity check hosts
Pages open and close again after the display sleeps or changes
Large files open in the editor without a pause
Profiles with many rules, groups or proxies open and update without stalling the screen
Pages that load their data open at once with a spinner instead of pausing before they slide in
Use less battery on Android in the background
Open list editors and pages over others more smoothly
Smoother dashboard and tab switches, with one redraw a second while connected
Smoother proxy pages when switching groups, sorting and scrolling
Swiping back on phones drops fewer frames
One status button gathers core, update and resource states, with counts, download progress and new card icons
Added rules can go to named custom exits; a profile's script and added rules run together and open from the extend page
PAC mode for the desktop system proxy; new Windows installs bypass <local>; GTK apps on KDE Plasma follow the proxy
respect-rules, hosts and cache-algorithm in the DNS overrides; macOS system DNS through tun.dns-mode native
Open a log on a phone to select and copy it
Geo resources update automatically by default
Impeller on Windows and Intel Macs; the Apple Silicon download no longer carries Intel code
Update the core to mihomo v1.19.34, with editor completion for its new keys
A start that fails or a lost Core says why; a mixed port of 0 is replaced; the mixed port opens without a profile
Process rules match by default; picked override keys are written as set, empty included
WireGuard, Hysteria2 and TUIC reconnect after a network change; core sockets opened before the VPN are protected
Service and exit IP checks no longer fail while the proxy starts, stops or changes network
HTTPUpgrade share links no longer import as WebSocket
App icons show whenever the app is known and keep their place while loading
macOS tray windows stay on the current Space; windows use the target display's scale; AppImage without a bundled libstdc++; cleaner deb removal; the Windows installer only stops its own processes
Pages open at the top and on the selected profile; sheets open from sheets as pages; the editor shows its spinner and grows its sheet; calmer success and warning colors; remote icons hold their size
Connections rank and sort off the UI thread; proxy and group icons use less memory
Merged requests and connections; quick edit lists
iOS 27 transitions, press and text selection; smoother pages
Download and install updates in the app
One delay test timeout; VPN crash and startup fixes
Auto-select leaves an unusable first node at once
Keep selections a filter hides
Access control state shown in a bar at the bottom
Optional general overrides; settings apply sooner
IP quality cached for 3 days; simpler Android dashboard
Update the core to mihomo v1.19.33
Colored tray status icons; monochrome option on macOS
Sidebar blur; Windows fixes; keeps system proxies FlClash didn't set
Profile QR codes, phone-to-TV links, more proxy fields
Add proxies to local proxies; adjustable delay test timeout
Higher-contrast dark mode and a refreshed app icon
iOS-style docked search and menus; bar buttons lift on hover
iOS-style switches, stretchy sheets, menus and long-press reordering
Pages scroll under the Android navigation bar
Clear the DNS cache by hand or on network change
Opening the app no longer reloads a running VPN
Smoother editor for large files and in sheets
Desktop TUN keys follow the profile unless picked; changed values carry over
French, Spanish and Korean translations
No more Firebase analytics or crash reporting
Per-key desktop TUN settings; system proxy and tray fixes
Redesigned theme colors and color styles
A redesigned dashboard around the current exit
Profile-detail resources and include-all in custom groups
Proxy groups as cards, group tabs as chips
Sortable tables for connections, requests and DNS
Optional two-tier Liquid Glass and slide-to-pick menus
iOS-style surfaces, alerts and sheets; clearer TV focus
Fix pasting and Chinese input in text fields
Large profiles no longer crash; downloads trust core CAs
Smoother Android UI while the proxy is busy
DNS and NTP override toggles are removed; picked keys apply to every profile
Custom overwrites are removed; rebuild them as custom profiles
Per-key DNS, NTP, sniffer and TUN settings
Custom profiles
Stacked sheets, context menus and a sort mode
DNS, Hosts and ports apply without a restart
Launcher shortcuts and one-step on-demand access
Share link import and mrs rule sets
Unreadable settings no longer block startup or restores
Windows and Linux desktop fixes
The elevated Core only answers its owner
Editor word wrap and snippets
More dashboard cards
Hide timed-out nodes and search every list
Sidebar, floating dock and drag to go back
New app glyphs, empty states and theme page
Invalid override warnings and rule presets
DNS query log and per-key DNS/NTP overrides
Proxied service checks and outbound IP risk
Tray hotkeys, node delays and a delay test
A changed resource link is now used by the next sync and by auto update
DNS lookups no longer fail on networks that report no DNS servers
Smaller icons in icon-only group headers
Push notifications reconnect in Doze
Restores never apply halfway
Refresh the geo file size and time after an update finishes
Keep the core running while Windows sleeps with the app suspended
Rework the app UI and refresh the localization
Rework the app layer and window handling, and add proxy authentication
Rework the desktop runners, packaging, and native build
Rework the Android VPN service and lifecycle handling
Rework the desktop plugins and add the Helper service and Rust bridge
Rework the core IPC and process lifecycle
